units.title: Literal representatives of Hermite classes
units.statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma_E=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\) be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. Let \(H_j\) be the unnormalized probabilists Hermite polynomial and put \(h_j(w)=[x\mapsto H_j(\langle w,x\rangle)]\in L^2(\gamma_E)\). For a finite set \(S\subset\mathbb N\) and real coefficients \(c_j\), put \(F_{S,c}(w)=\sum_{j\in S}c_jh_j(w)\). For every degree \(j\) and every ambient \(w\), the representative of \(h_j(w)\) equals the literal Hermite ridge almost everywhere under \(\gamma_E\).
assumptions: The finite-dimensional real inner-product and Borel structures are the actual structures on the same carrier \(E\).
\(\gamma_E\) is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. No positive dimension restriction is imposed.
\(j\) and \(w\) are arbitrary. The equality is almost everywhere, not a pointwise choice of representatives.

steps.title: Use the toLp representative identity
steps.text: Unfold the class definition and apply the almost-everywhere representative theorem for \(\operatorname{toLp}\). Evaluation after the coefficient map is the same as real algebra evaluation of the integer polynomial.
steps.lean:
theorem gaussianHermiteRidgeL2_ae (j : ℕ) (w : E) :
    (gaussianHermiteRidgeL2 j w : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[stdGaussian E]
      fun x => aeval ⟪w,x⟫_ℝ (hermite j) := by
  unfold gaussianHermiteRidgeL2
  filter_upwards [MemLp.coeFn_toLp (f := fun x : E =>
    ((hermite j).map (algebraMap ℤ ℝ)).eval ⟪w,x⟫_ℝ)
    (Classical.choose
      (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.GaussianPolynomialRidgeSmooth.standard_gaussian_polynomial_ridge_L2_smooth
        (E := E) ((hermite j).map (algebraMap ℤ ℝ))) w)] with x hx
  rw [hx]
  exact eval_map_algebraMap _ _
